theorem study_q_reciprocal (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : 1 / y ≤ 1 / x := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_q_reciprocal (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : 1 / y ≤ 1 / x
:= by
  have hxy_pos : 0 < y := by
    exact div_pos hxy hx
  have h_inv_x_le_inv_y : 1 / x ≤ 1 / y := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff (by linarith [hx])]
    exact hxy_pos
  rw [le_comm] at h_inv_x_le_inv_y
  exact h_inv_x_le_inv_y
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_q_reciprocal = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_q_reciprocal := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
